reviews.text:
I had a window broken from one side only.
I reached out to several other companies. And they all told me that I needed to replace the entire window.
I called A&E glass and they told me they could replace just the broken side without having to replace the entire window.  And Thats was what I was looking for.
They came out quickly, gave me a quote and were able to do the work that same day.
reviews.author: Ocho Sanz

reviews.text: Wow this is the best thing experience I’ve had in a LONG time. Crystal was SOO quick to get back to me and helped me with such a great price. Sammy and Emily WERE amazing! Made sure everything was perfect before they left. It didn’t feel awkward either..  it truly felt like a family was helping a family!! I would recommend them to everyone!! Seeing Sammy and Emily work together was awesome. This family is a true team! If I could give 10 stars I would!

reviews.text: Definitely would NOT recommend using this company. The transaction was shady from the start, with Crystal(owner or manager) telling us over and over that it would be tomorrow, then it was the next day, ect. We waited well over a month to get this installed after it was ordered.  During install, they caused over $200 in damage to the wall(fresh drywall and paint) then proceeded to not want to take care of it until given an ultimatum. Claimed it was a "50 cent fix" and then walked back into the customer's home, without knocking (and after leaving). They refused to leave the customer's home, scaring the homeowner. Hmmm.... Will not use again, and recommend you do not either.

reviews.text:
Pure and simple, these folks are fraudsters and scammers. Now that I have your attention allow me to explain why I will give them two stars. They are a small "company" which is really just a Husband and Wife with their daughter helping out. Nothing wrong with that.

They sold me on replacing the glass through my entire house with three promises, in writing. #1 That the job would take 11 days. (Quote received and downpayment made on January 20th, it's now May 6th and still not done) #2. Cash discount (they made good on that) and #3. That there would be a 10 year warranty.

They have yet to respond about finishing the job as they installed the wrong glass on the front door. The glass on the front door is also the wrong size and lets wind through. They are choosing to ignore my text messages about the warranty and finishing the job. Sammy claims to be blind now, which if true, sure, but then why not give me the warranty information for the glass?

They install with extremely poor craftsmanship. They broke several panes of glass in their attempt to install at my home. Which made them have to come back several times. They also measured wrong and had to come back for that as well. To his credit they did come back several times.

Do not hire this "company" they are a scam, and liars.
reviews.author: Octavian Drake

reviews.text:
BEWARE!!!        I have been dealing with this company for a year at this point. I had many window panes replaced but it took months and months for the work to be completed. There are two window panes still not replaced as well as solar screens that were paid in full in advance, never installed.  Deposits paid for the glass but glass not installed and they ran out of the plastic glazing that holds the glass in on at least 5 windows so the glass is not secure in those windows. Job site not cleaned well nor glass cleaned. My son cut his foot on pieces of broken glass left in our home. I was constantly cleaning up behind them.

This company is a small family owned business, which I try to support, but they do not run a professional business. Communication is horrible, the customer has to contact them multiple times to get an update or status on work.

If they do answer a call or email and set an appointment for install, they do NOT show up most of the time but never call to tell you why or to reschedule.  There is excuse after excuse as to why they couldn't come as scheduled. They never seem to be able to get help so the husband and wife are the only people working.

They were reasonably priced and Sammy genuinely appears to be very knowledgeable about window replacement but it is next to impossible to get them to finish the job without constant hounding.   PLEASE use a different company, even if it costs more.  I have lost money and will have to pay to have the work completed properly.
reviews.author: Shae Craft

reviews.text: They did an incredible job fixing my windows. They are very professional and the work they did was beyond what I expected.  The customer service was definitely five star. I highly recommend them.

reviews.text: Called A&E Glass and received a quote in less than 5min, work was completed the following day. Very happy with how fast they took care of replacing my window. Thanks again A&E glass, will defiantly recommend you guys.

reviews.text: After seeing some of the reviews on here I was hesitant at first to use this company BUT so happy we went with them. Made several phone calls and Sammy was the first to respond and even came out and gave me a free estimate on a Saturday. Gave him 50% down and he was back that week to install. He did a great job & we would definitely use them again.

reviews.text: Came out the day after calling, measured cracked window, happened to have size needed in truck. Quick, clean installation, very reasonable with extensive warranty.

Great service and great communication. They made it easy and were quick to answer any questions I had. Will definitely use them again in the future.

They took my money and never came back to install the windows. I ended up paying another company to install the windows for me. They should have at least given me my money back if they didn't want to complete the job instead of giving me the run around and eventually ending all communication with me. BUYER'S PLEASE BEWARE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.text: Great experience. Windows look great. I called the day after Christmas which happens to be Sunday.  🎄 They fit me in same day. The man was very pleasant professional. Treated my emergency situation with ease. He was able to install from the outside of my home. I was amazed at at how easy everything was. The woman that answered was great. The technician called me quickly to confirm details. He text me when he was arriving. He texted me when the job was completed. I even got a text to thank me for business. Highly recommended!! 10 out of 10 stars 🌟😀

reviews.text: Got a cannot-be-beat quote from A&E Glass for the replacement of five double-paned windows, one screen and caulking of all windows. Wet weather and freezing temps delayed the work, but the first day the weather was good, the work was completed in a professional, efficient manner. New windows were left sparkling, ground debris and old glass were removed, did a great job cleaning up. I highly recommend Crystal and Sammy—job well done for an exceptionally fair price!
reviews.author: Barbara Bibbiani

reviews.text: We got a quote from several companies for replacing around 26 window panes and A&E offered the best quote and they also had exceptional service.  I have lived in my house since 1986 and after living here for around 5 years all our windows fogged up from a leak between the panes.  I have lived with that situation for so long, I didn't realize just how nice looking out our windows could be until we replaced all the panes.  I actually enjoy having the blinds and drapes completely open now so i can see outside.  I would highly recommend A&E Glass for any glass products and service they have to offer.

reviews.text:
I contacted them 3 weeks ago to repair a bedroom window at the front of my house that a neighbors kid broke and they came out a few days later to take measurements. After paying the deposit for the window to be repaired, I still haven’t gotten it fixed. It’s been 3 weeks, no window fixed, $175 deposit gone, and no communication about when someone will come complete the job. At this point, I feel I’m being scammed and this is NOT a legitimate business! DO NOT RECOMMEND!

***UPDATE: 2 months after paying and booking their service, chasing them down to simply respond, and having to resort to filing a police report, THEY DECIDED THAT THEY WOULD GIVE ME ONLY THE GLASS THEY HAD CUT TO FIX MY WINDOW(WHICH IS WHAT THE DEPOSIT PAID FOR) BECAUSE THEY WERE UPSET ABOUT ME GETTING THE POLICE INVOLVED AND LEAVING THIS REVIEW AND OPTED NOT TO FINISH THE JOB AND REPAIR THE WINDOW. The police gave them the option to walk away without legally being binded to finishing the job because I only paid the deposit thus far. All in all, THANK GOD ITS OVER, STILL DO NOT RECOMMEND, WORST BUSINESS AND CUSTOMER SERVICE IVE EVER EXPERIENCED…NEGATIVE 0 STARS!

data.summary: Reviews show strong evidence of authentic, severe customer dissatisfaction. The pattern of complaints (delays, damage, unprofessionalism) is consistent and detailed across multiple reviewers. The positive reviews are fewer, less detailed, and some appear potentially inauthentic or from connected parties. The business has significant operational and customer service problems, as confirmed by the BBB 'F' rating and low Angi score.
fake_signals: Potential family/friend reviews (e.g., 'Mario Guzman' review is generic and from another business owner)
Extremely positive reviews lack specific project details and use overly emotional, repetitive praise
High volume of negative reviews contain highly specific, credible allegations of fraud and unprofessional conduct
authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain specific dates, names (Crystal, Sammy, Emily), amounts, and detailed sequences of events
Writing styles vary significantly between positive and negative reviews
Some positive reviews mention specific solutions (replacing one side of a window)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Major discrepancy between Google (4.1) and Angi (2.4) ratings. BBB 'F' rating indicates serious unresolved complaints or business practice issues.
